_source: Curated ForeignGrammarDef entries (schema Category K) for commands whose Text parameters embed a grammar this corpus has no authority to validate. A final corpus-assembly step is expected to merge these into the root IR document's top-level "foreignGrammars" map.

SQLWhereClauseWithExpressionSubstitution.note: A SQL-2-compliant boolean search-condition fragment (the WHERE-clause of an implicit "SELECT * FROM table WHERE ..."), evaluated by 4D's own integrated SQL engine (not an external SQL connection). Can additionally embed references to 4D expressions/variables using the same <> or :MyVar substitution syntax supported inside Begin SQL/End SQL blocks and the other integrated SQL commands -- so the full grammar is SQL-2 plus this 4D-specific expression-substitution extension, which is why it is modeled as its own foreignGrammars entry rather than a plain 'SQL' one.
